source_snapshot.criteria: SOL establishes successfully and displays human-readable characters.
source_snapshot.script: Private sol-session-by-ipmitool_oob; 15 attended and 15 machine minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; opens SOL through a pipeline capped at 60 lines and asks the user to confirm the banner, but exposes command-line credentials and does not verify live focus or cleanup.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly recognizes interactivity, but a truncated stream is not evidence of a live controllable console or the right target/channel.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly makes human visual/context confirmation the essential action while allowing automation only for safe setup and evidence capture.
historical_reviews.history: No earlier exact source identity record exists.
historical_reviews.v3_1: SOL can display cached or stale text even when live input routing is wrong. Human-readable output must therefore be paired with independent target/channel identity and a live, harmless observation at a known safe console state; a banner alone is insufficient.

original_test_intent: Have an authorized operator establish OOB SOL to the intended SUT console and confirm live human-readable output, correct focus and clean session closure without changing system state.
original_method: Verify BMC/SUT/serial-channel mapping and console parameters independently; open the protected interactive SOL session; visually confirm target-specific live output; optionally use one harmless marker only at an approved safe prompt; observe readability, echo, ordering and latency; close SOL and verify no lock or unintended input remains.
manual_activity: An authorized operator verifies console identity/focus, judges live character readability and interaction context, performs any harmless marker action and confirms the session is closed without a lock.
required_inputs: Approved safe prompt or observation point
safety_requirements: Do not substitute a static or truncated capture for live confirmation
Do not send shell, bootloader, power, reset or storage commands
Stop on wrong target, garbling, duplication or loss
Never retry automatically after a lock or ambiguous focus
agent_execution_scope: Prepare protected SOL client and evidence capture
Present the live session to the operator
Record operator observations without deciding verdict
Verify clean session close and no state change
engineer_actions: Visually judge live readability and focus
Approve and enter any harmless marker

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `sol activate` targets the right interface, but piping interactive output through `head` can terminate or distort the session and cannot prove live focus, readability or cleanup; credentials are also exposed.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: MANUAL ONLY: open protected `ipmitool sol activate` interactively on the verified target/channel, let the operator judge live output and close it using the supported escape/cleanup procedure.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The OOB SOL path and 15/15-minute interactive observation remain; blanket log clearing and non-interactive truncation are removed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture target/channel configuration, session start, redacted live console frames, operator readability/focus checklist, any harmless-marker round trip, session end and lock-free verification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds independent identity, safe-input boundaries and explicit session lifecycle evidence around the manual observation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A successful process start or readable banner cannot show that the current console is live, correctly focused or safely controllable.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Visual/context judgment cannot be reduced to a parser because expected console content varies with boot and OS state; automation must not claim the verdict.

project_override_considerations: The Project must provide the authoritative BMC-to-serial mapping and expected console state. Testing keyboard commands, login, bootloader control or power behavior is outside this row unless separately approved.
expected_evidence: Target identity, SOL channel/serial mapping and console parameters
Operator-attended redacted session start and live output capture
Optional harmless-marker evidence at a safe prompt
Preserved BMC/SOL/SEL/OS audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, command and criteria consistently target OOB SOL establishment and human-readable output. Missing channel/focus/cleanup detail is an execution prerequisite, not a competing objective.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The serial mapping, protected client and operator are obtainable inputs. A run reports BLOCKED if the correct channel, safe console state or clean session control cannot be established.

review_improvement: Prevents a truncated banner from being accepted as a live correct-target SOL session and bounds the privileged interactive surface to operator-observed, harmless activity.
independent_technical_reasoning: SOL establishment is not equivalent to correct console routing: a BMC may attach to the wrong UART or preserve stale screen content. A live target-specific observation and known focus are needed. Because even pasted newline characters can execute at a privileged prompt, the evidence plan must minimize input and treat clean session release as part of acceptance.
